facts.fact_text: The first applicant participated in a demonstration organised by the opposition on 20 October 2012.
The second applicant participated in a demonstration organised by the opposition on 20 October 2012.
The second applicant participated in a demonstration held on 12 January 2013.
The second applicant participated in a demonstration held on 26 January 2013.
The third applicant participated in a demonstration held on 30 April 2013.
According to the applicants, the demonstrations were intended to be peaceful and were conducted in a peaceful manner.
The police began to disperse the demonstration of 20 October 2012 as soon as the protesters began to gather.
The police began to disperse the demonstration of 12 January 2013 as soon as the protesters began to gather.
The police began to disperse the demonstration of 26 January 2013 as soon as the protesters began to gather.
The police began to disperse the demonstration of 30 April 2013 as soon as the protesters began to gather.
On 15 October 2012, prior to the demonstration of 20 October 2012, the organisers gave notice to the Baku City Executive Authority (the BCEA).
The Baku City Executive Authority (the BCEA) refused to authorise the holding of the demonstration at the place indicated by the organisers.

The Baku City Executive Authority (the BCEA) proposed a different location on the outskirts of Baku — the grounds of a driving school situated in the 20th residential area of the Sabail District — as an alternative venue for the demonstration.
